import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from joblib import Parallel, delayed
from utils import single_SVD, plot_distribution, p_rademacher, p_uniform, p_student_t
from functools import partial
from typing import Callable, Tuple, Dict

plt.rcParams['mathtext.fontset'] = 'stix'
plt.rcParams['font.family'] = 'serif'
plt.rcParams['axes.titlesize'] = 20
plt.rcParams['axes.labelsize'] = 18
plt.rcParams['xtick.labelsize'] = 16
plt.rcParams['ytick.labelsize'] = 16
plt.rcParams['legend.fontsize'] = 16

params_base = {"c_1": 1.0, "v_x": 1.0, "v_w": 1.0}
n_bins = 45
n_jobs = 3

%load_ext autoreload
%autoreload 2
In [4]:
def run(seed: int, params: Dict, return_pdf: bool, ext: str | int, 
        x_range: Tuple | None = None, y_range: Tuple | None = None, 
        p_dist: Callable | None = None, split_outliers: bool = False):

    # params["n_mc"]: number of independent random matrix realizations
    results = Parallel(n_jobs=n_jobs)(
        delayed(single_SVD)(params, seed + i, p_dist) for i in range(params["n_mc"])
    )
    _, sing, ranks = zip(*results)
    assert len(set(ranks)) == 1, f"Inconsistent numerical ranks: {set(ranks)}"
    rank_Q = ranks[0]
    all_singvals = np.concatenate(sing)
    plot_distribution(data=all_singvals, params=params, n_bins=n_bins, 
                      x_range=x_range, y_range=y_range, rank_Q=rank_Q, 
                      return_pdf=return_pdf, ext=ext, split_outliers=split_outliers)
